stayAsIsRationale.Pagination prev/next/page (Faq.tsx, Blog: Owned by the published <Pagination> component, not raw markup. Already canonical. fullWidthMobile=false is the intent (toolbar pattern); the Pagination component owns this internally.
stayAsIsRationale.Filter chip tabs (Faq.tsx, BlogListing.t: These are CHIP-style filters with horizontal scroll on mobile, not buttons. Different visual category — kept distinct.
stayAsIsRationale.Amount preset buttons (BuyMeCoffee.tsx:3: Tab-button pattern (4 amount choices, exclusive selection). Closer to a radio-group than a button. Migrating to <Button> would lose the visual selection treatment.
stayAsIsRationale.Role/Context/Budget cards (PlaygroundOnb: Card-selection pattern, not buttons. Each card has multi-line content (label + description). <Button> isn't appropriate.
stayAsIsRationale.Theme toggle and Hamburger (SiteHeader.t: Already canonical icon-button shape (w-9 h-9 rounded-cl-md). Migrating to <Button variant="icon"> would just rename the class set; the visual is identical. Keeping as-is to limit blast radius; can be migrated in a follow-up.
stayAsIsRationale.UserMenu trigger and Logout menuitem (Us: Inside a Dropdown. The Dropdown component owns its trigger and menuitem styling.
stayAsIsRationale.Faq.tsx Email + GitHub multi-row CTAs: Custom row pattern (icon + label + URL + description + arrow). Not a single-line button. The pattern is intentional and unique to this section.

summary.currentlyFullWidthOnMobile: Only Hero CTAs (correct). FaqSection mobile CTA, BlogSection mobile CTA, SiteHeader drawer CTA, Onboarding step nav: all currently inline on mobile, will become full-width via the new Button component's variant default.
summary.rule: Primary + secondary variants render w-full sm:w-auto by default. fullWidthMobile={false} opts out. Ghost + icon stay w-auto always. Comments required when opting out.
